scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Corporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
^ff0000{0}^000000公會成員，歡迎光臨。
無論您去往何處，卡普拉總公司都與您同在。

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用倉庫

scripts.text: Use Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 使用瞬間移動服務

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，您需要將初心者基本技能提升至6級，才能使用倉庫服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
這就為您開啟倉庫。
感謝您使用卡普拉服務。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
請選擇您的目的地。

scripts.text: Al De Baran -> 200z
scripts.translation: 阿爾德巴蘭 -> 200 Zeny

scripts.text: Geffen -> 200z

scripts.text: Payon -> 200z

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists, Biochemists,
Mechanics and Geneticists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，手推車租賃服務僅限商人、鐵匠、神工匠、鍊金術士、創造者、機匠和基因學者使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
您已經有一輛手推車了。
每位顧客同時只能租用一輛。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
手推車租賃費是800 Zeny。
您要租一輛手推車嗎？

scripts.translation: 取消

[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足，無法支付800 Zeny的手推車租賃費。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
卡普拉總公司始終致力於為您提供最優質的服務。
希望我們的服務能滿足您的冒險需求，不負您的期望。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I am instructed to only offer my services to the ^ff0000{0}^000000 Guild. Please try another Kafra Employee around here. Sorry for the inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉職員]
我奉命只為^ff0000{0}^000000公會提供服務。
請向附近其他卡普拉職員尋求幫助。
給您帶來不便，敬請諒解。

scripts.translation: 每天可以投資一次，若投入更多資金，還可以再投資一次。

[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
I worked so hard... How can you do that, Master?... Please... Please reconsider... Check it again, Master... Please...
scripts.translation:
[受僱的卡普拉職員]
我一直這麼努力...主人，您怎麼能這樣？
求您了...請再考慮一下...
主人，請您再想想...求您了...

scripts.text: [ Hired Kafra Employee ]

scripts.text: Fire

天哪！這太荒唐了！

Master, we can't hire a Kafra Employee because we don't have a contract with the Kafra Main Office. If you want to obtain a contract with the Kafra Main Office, you will need to learn the Guild skill first.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
主人，我們尚未與卡普拉總部簽訂契約，無法僱傭卡普拉職員。
需要先學習相應的公會技能，才能與總部簽約。

[{0}]

[{0}]
嗯...很抱歉，資金不足，無法僱傭卡普拉職員。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

How do you do? I was dispatched from the Main Office.
I'll do my best to not tarnish the reputation of the Guild.

您好，我是總部派來的職員。
我會努力工作，不辱公會的聲譽。

[{0}]
受僱的卡普拉職員合同期限為一個月，期滿後需要續交費用。

[{0}]
遵照您的吩咐辦了，不過有些成員可能會不高興。
還是儘快僱傭一名卡普拉職員比較好。
